svg.title: Read service state, messages and HTTP contents.
svg.desc: For the running local web-demo.service, selected illustrative outputs distinguish active running state, a stored GET request message and an HTTP response body Hello. journalctl -n 20 -f initially shows the latest twenty messages then follows new messages. Ctrl-C stops only that follower; q exits a paged status view. Missing journal output can reflect retention or permissions and is not proof of a healthy service.
svg.text: Local web-demo.service; demo page contains Hello. Illustrative selected output:
Latest 20 messages, then follow new ones. Illustrative message excerpt:
Stop following with Ctrl-C before checking the page:
Ctrl-C stops this log follower, not the service. q exits a paged status view.
Journal storage/permissions vary. Missing logs or “active” do not prove the page works.
